verdict.rationale: All scripting documentation describes JavaScript/TypeScript ESM class-based scripts (playcanvas-docs-2, playcanvas-docs-12, playcanvas-docs-15) with no mention of a node-based or visual scripting system; the Editor is described as drag-and-drop scene building but explicitly code-driven for logic. Visual scripting is a reasonable axis for a game engine (comparable engines offer it), but no evidence shows PlayCanvas provides it.
